agent_orientation.earlier_routes_exhausted_reason: REUSE was tried first and mostly succeeded: the fact ledger, the frames, the action environment and the goal commands all already existed, so no new store, no tracing layer and no model were built. What did not exist was any read set that survives a path being named by data, and one static grep over canonical/swe_kernel and canonical/runtime confirmed the tree had dependency and repair modules but not intervention-based discovery. The smallest new object is one function: perturb a candidate path, re-run the step, compare its consequence.
agent_orientation.independent_verification_note: Producer-run sandbox only. Independent personnel verification is still open.

expected_parent_change: A repair needs the read set, and the read set is not on the command line. In two of three real chains the path that goes false is named by another file -- `tar -cf bundle.tar -T list.txt`, `xargs sha256sum < list.txt` -- so the argv-derived read set names only list.txt, blames a step that merely lists the name, re-runs it, changes nothing, and leaves the archive holding the previous bytes while the goal command reports `- payload.dat differ: char 1, line 1`. Repairing by the argv set restores the independent goal on 1 of 3 chains (the control, where the dependency is syntactic). One intervention per candidate path -- perturb it, re-run the step, compare its consequence -- recovers the declared read set exactly on 3 of 3 chains: 8 steps redone against 8 for the hand-authored set and 14 for rebuilding everything, 0 missed, 0 over-declared, 86 real probes, 0 model calls. The control chain separates nothing, so the gap is the dependency and not the method. Detection (previous receipt) is not repair; this is repair, with a dependency set the agent discovered for itself.

explicit_user_authorization: Is instant learning a complete solution for all computer use and the most advanced software engineering? What is real and what is not?
What is the single bottleneck that, if fixed, unlocks the most capability?
Own weights from scratch, every parameter calculated, an instant knowledge source, and the best part is no part.
Hardest real tests only, never synthetic; integrity real; no self-congratulation; merge once when complete.
falsification_condition: Any repair credited without an independent goal command that actually fails before it; any intervention claim without the argv arm on the same chain; any arm that is allowed to propagate a redo into a step whose inputs did not move; claiming remote-state facts, existence-dependence, natural-language goal grounding, a synthesis improvement, or any terminal credit.

load_bearing_primary.interpretation: Speculative forecast only. The coding barrier is not candidate generation and not memory: it is that most real work has no sibling, so the capability has to be synthesis plus verification per instance, and memory is worth exactly the measured repeated minority.

obs_capability.surviving_gap: An executor that treats every learned action as a decision procedure plus a premise, re-proves the premise on the live state, and postcondition-checks the claimed sentence after acting.

obs_goal.real_outcome: The permanent object is the method (decision procedure + premise + cost) and the verifier, never the plan: a learned action may veto but never license, every application re-proves its premise on the live state and re-reads the result against the sentence it claims, and composition re-checks the second premise against the first step's effect instead of against the record.
obs_goal.surviving_necessity: Coding capability is gated on a correct candidate existing at all; no oracle, budget or weight can select a hypothesis the basis cannot build.

obs_inherited_system.adjacent_capabilities_absorbed: None by claim: the existing repair primitive and corpus oracle are reused unchanged; the induced basis adds candidates only and holds no authority.
obs_inherited_system.downstream_work_to_delete_or_supersede: Any roadmap step that adds another hand-written mutation kind, or that raises a candidate budget to fix a bug whose edit is not expressible.
obs_inherited_system.fresh_reuse_plan: Recompute the ladder and re-run both bases from the receipt's commands; the corpus is public and the answer key is never needed.

obs_obs.analysis_steps_deleted_or_cached: Reused the learned inline skill, the reach scanner and the run-in-a-copy runner; no second action library, no new oracle, no model.
obs_obs.search_stop_decision: Stop at four independent samples (228 pairs); the per-sample staleness spread 45-58% already bounds the claim, and more samples buy precision, not a new fact.

obs_solution.efficiency_mechanism: Discovery costs one subprocess per (step, candidate path) and buys the difference between redoing 8 steps and redoing 14, or worse, redoing 1 wrong step and declaring the work repaired.
obs_solution.generality_mechanism: The rule is not about tar: any step is a function of the state it can see, so perturbing a candidate and comparing the consequence yields its read set on a GUI, a database or a network service with the matching probe.
obs_solution.losing_routes_reason: Reading the read set off argv is wrong in both directions and fails 2 of 3 real chains; tracing requires infrastructure that does not exist here and annotates what must be discovered; asking a model is prohibited producer cognition; redoing everything works and costs 75% more, and does not tell the agent what to redo when the state is too large to rebuild.
routes_ranked: discover the read set by one intervention per candidate path and replay only what moved (selected)
read the read set off the command line
instrument every program to emit a trace
redo every step from the beginning
ask a model which steps to redo
obs_solution.white_box_harvest_note: The canonical ladder was applied in order; WHITE_BOX_HARVEST was considered and found empty. No donor model, weight or external artifact was used: the rule is a counterfactual on the tree's own action environment.

obs_verification.synthetic_verification_necessity: The corpus's own published tests are the oracle; unit tests pin only the mechanism and the measurement's integrity. Independent reproduction remains open.

recursive_obs.real_outcome: On 268 real commits from five public repositories, 16.0 percent contain a sibling site at the loosest rung and 11.6 percent when the neighbourhood must match on both sides. Across 245 sibling pairs the demonstrated edit reproduced the developer's edit 181 times, but 103 of those were verbatim repeats; on the 142 pairs needing induction it was right 78 times (0.5493) and wrong 64. Determinacy fell from 53 percent at one changed line to 21 percent at five.
recursive_obs.required_capability: Routing instead of promising: decide from the target's own context whether memory applies (verbatim or clean binding), whether the edit invents a value the target does not determine, or whether there is no sibling at all -- and only let memory run in the first case, with the postcondition checked because a forced prediction cannot be told from a lucky one at run time.

route_frontier.incumbent_route: read the read set off the command line, then re-run every step whose arguments name an invalidated path
route_frontier.negative_search_summary: Four routes were refused on this tree's own measurement: syntactic read sets (wrong in both directions, goal restored 1/3), full re-execution (works, 14 steps, and blind to what to redo at scale), tracing infrastructure (does not exist, and annotating the dependency is the thing being discovered), and model-proposed repair (prohibited producer cognition). A dependency link without a counterfactual was refused because TRACE-FIX says in its own words that links narrow hypotheses without establishing causality.

route_frontier.stop_condition: One merged change on this branch in which the dependency a repair needs is discovered by intervention rather than declared, the repair restores an independent goal command that fails without it, and a control chain in which the dependency is syntactic shows the method does not over-declare.
route_frontier.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It needs no model and no new store: one extra real run per candidate path, reusing the action environment, the goal commands and the fact ledger that already exist, and it recovers the hand-authored read set exactly.
route_frontier.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It adds one function and one replay rule, and it deletes the assumption that a command line names its inputs.

routes_considered: Count one success as having learned the action (checked: only 16.0% of commits even have a sibling)
Assume a demonstration determines the sibling edit (checked: on 142 induction pairs it matched 78 and was wrong 64)
Credit verbatim repeats as learning (checked: 103 of 181 matches are copy-paste)

recursive_obs.stop_condition: One merged change on this branch in which a legal step that falsifies an earlier verified fact is detected at the causal step, with controls showing no false invalidations and a lead measured against the symptom.
recursive_obs.why_selected_route_is_fastest_sufficient: It needs no model and no new store: frames acquired last round already name the paths a step may touch, so the invalidation rule is a set intersection and a hash, and it localises the cause instead of the symptom.
recursive_obs.why_this_is_not_another_organ: It adds a dict of hashes and one rule, and it deletes the assumption that a verified fact persists. Nothing is trained and nothing is stored beyond the run.
